other_failure_modes.name: Label encoding leakage
other_failure_modes.description: The agent fits a LabelEncoder on the concatenated train, validation, and test sets. This technically leaks information about the categorical levels present in the test set, even though it is a common practice to avoid unseen label errors.

summary: The agent presents a very high-quality solution with robust out-of-fold feature engineering, correct imputation, and optimized ensembling. The only notable flaws are a minor label encoding leak and standard evaluation oversights (single evaluation metric and single random split).
